slot.brief: Person in an accelerating lift; ask for the normal reaction (apparent weight) for upward or downward acceleration.

stem: A person of mass $60$ kg stands on a weighing machine in a lift accelerating downward at $2$ m s$^{-2}$. Taking $g=10$ m s$^{-2}$, what does the machine read?

verdicts.working: For downward acceleration, the reading is the normal force: $N=m(g-a)=60(10-2)=480\text{ N}$.

working:

solution:
The weighing machine reads the normal force. For downward acceleration, $N=m(g-a)$.
$$N=60(10-2)=480\text{ N}$$
